title: PID-Gated Continual Prompt Adaptation Under Noisy Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.16129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying LLM agents in non-stationary environments requires continually revising their instructions as the task drifts, yet rewriting after every reported mistake can turn noisy feedback into persistent errors. This raises an often-overlooked scheduling question in prompt adaptation: when should feedback trigger a lasting instruction update, and at what editor-call cost? Taking inspiration from proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control, we introduce a family of lightweight gates that react to the current error, accumulate evidence over time, and roll back deterioration after an edit. We benchmark these gates against both simple baselines and advanced prompt optimizers (TextGrad and GEPA), over a diverse suite of drifting tasks, LLM parameter sizes, feedback-noise levels, and random seeds. translated_title: 噪声反馈下基于PID门控的持续提示自适应
translated_abstract: 在非平稳环境中部署大语言模型（LLM）智能体，需要随着任务漂移而不断修订其指令，然而每次收到报告的错误就进行重写，可能会把噪声反馈变成持久性的错误。这在提示自适应中提出了一个常被忽视的调度问题：反馈应该在什么时候触发一次持久性的指令更新？又要付出多大的编辑器调用成本？受比例-积分-微分（PID）控制的启发，我们提出了一族轻量级门控机制，它们对当前误差做出反应、随时间积累证据，并在一次编辑之后回滚恶化情况。我们在多样化的漂移任务套件、不同的LLM参数规模、反馈噪声水平和随机种子下，将这些门控与简单基线以及先进的提示优化器（TextGrad和GEPA）进行了基准比较。结果表明，PID门控的持续提示自适应在任务性能（高准确率、低错误）与编辑器调用成本之间实现了更有利的帕累托权衡。
tldr: 受PID控制启发，该论文提出轻量级门控机制来决定噪声反馈何时触发LLM智能体提示的持久性更新，从而在任务性能与编辑器调用成本之间取得更优的帕累托权衡。
en_tdlr: Inspired by PID control, this paper introduces lightweight gates that determine when noisy feedback should trigger lasting prompt updates for LLM agents, achieving a favorable Pareto trade-off between task performance and editor-call cost.
